why: The brief leaves real choices and outside work. It does not know which function sign-up uses to make a store from a preset ('find it; else createDemoStore'). storeArtPicture() takes no uploader (content-packs.ts:108 reads from public/ or fetches), so production code must gain a dependency it does not have. The two real WOFF2 font files must be obtained from outside the repo. A seed that runs server code under a new Vitest config must be added to CI before the build.
harm_if_wrong: A wrong uploader seam in storeArtPicture() changes how production stores theme pictures, or a seed that builds a fake store gives budgets that measure a fiction.
make_it_cheaper: Name the store-making call (createDemoStore + publishDemoStore), write the storeArtPicture() uploader parameter as an exact signature in its own earlier step, and commit the two font fixtures before the brief is handed out.
brief_problems: Step (6) treats it as open whether storeArtPicture() takes an uploader; it does not (src/server/content-packs.ts:108 has only owner and art).
The font fixtures must come from 'the fonts' own public repository or a developer machine'. A fresh session in this sandbox has neither.
Commit 2 relies on helpers step 1.3 adds (documentOf, the count helper of e2e/prefetch.spec.ts) without naming their signatures.
